denominator_rules.failure_stage_and_error_types: 798 technically failed TEs; error types are non-exclusive
denominator_rules.semantic_profile_analysis: 355 technically accepted, non-abstaining CEPs only; technical failures and accepted cultural abstentions are excluded
denominator_rules.facet_prevalence: TE-level multi-label prevalence among technically accepted, non-abstaining CEPs; facet percentages do not sum to 100%
denominator_rules.salience_and_component_coverage: supported TE-facet pairs among accepted non-abstaining CEPs; descriptive generated-output distributions, not gold-standard accuracy

interpretation_guardrails: CP12 is descriptive scale-up analysis, not a replacement for CP9 human-reference accuracy evaluation.
Do not calculate precision, recall, F1, QWK, or coverage error against truth on the 1,441 TEs because no full human gold reference exists for them.
Do not treat technical failures as negative cultural predictions.
Do not include accepted cultural abstentions in facet, salience, or component-coverage prevalence denominators.
Destination/platform differences are descriptive unless a separate inferential analysis is explicitly specified.
